channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Eric Paschall | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Eric Paschall from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kent Bazemore on Eric Paschall
item.description:
Wes Goldberg:Kent Bazemore:

“Eric Paschall is an amazing mismatch at the five for us. We really missed him against Indiana. I think if he plays, it's a totally different outcome.”

Kent Bazemore on Eric Paschall, Jan 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @wcgoldberg.

item.title: Damion Lee on Eric Paschall
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Damion Lee on Eric Paschall's false-positive coronavirus test:

“This virus is nothing to play with, whether it's a false-positive or an actual positive.... It'll be great having EP back out there tomorrow.”

Damion Lee on Eric Paschall, Jan 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Draymond Green on Eric Paschall
item.description:
Draymond Green on if Eric Paschall (knee) needs to miss time:

“It might be a blessing if he has to miss a week or two. Things came at him really fast. ... He handled it well, but it may not be the worst thing if he has to miss a week or two.”

Draymond Green on Eric Paschall, Dec 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Draymond Green on Eric Paschall
item.description:
Draymond Green on Eric Paschall, who had 30 more last night:

“Right now, he’s just scoring off raw talent. He really don’t know how to play the NBA game. As he figures out more and more the NBA game, how to get fouled, he’ll get better and better.”

Draymond Green on Eric Paschall, Nov 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.
